recoveryBridgeHaltKey.meaning: present (any value) => ethBridge refuses transferToSidechain/requestFromSidechain with RecoveryHalted

guardianHaltKey.meaning: present => guardians halted bridge workers (SCALE {number:u32, block:u32}); peers stop signing until operators resume

denomination.note: denominator = 10^38 (applies to the bridge only for TBCD; XOR bridge factor is 1)

recoveryCompletion.note: transient keys count as present even with an empty value; status = (u32 LE version, [32] policy, u8 phase, u32 LE chunks, u64 LE operation, u8 failure_tag), 50 bytes; terminal-audit = ([32] active, [32] audit, u32 LE chunks), 68 bytes

cases.name: live 2026-11-24 (spec 142): complete; legacy bridge-halt key is ignored

operatorSignerReport.requiredSignaturesRule: peers - floor((peers-1)/3) + (pendingPeer(0).isSome ? 1 : 0); live peers 3, pendingPeer None => 3

bridgeProxy.rules: outgoing Thischain: locked += amount (+limit); outgoing Sidechain: locked -= amount (NotEnoughLockedLiquidity); incoming owned: locked -= amount; incoming Sidechain: locked += amount
